mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer (login_id, password, name, birth_date, email, phone, emergency, zipcode, road_address, detail_address) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{password}, #{name}, #{birthDate}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{emergency}, #{zipcode}, #{roadAddress}, #{detailAddress})
mapper.select: SELECT id, login_id, name, birth_date, email, phone, emergency, zipcode, road_address, detail_address, is_withdrawn AS withdrawn, created_at FROM customer WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE customer SET phone = #{phone}, emergency = #{emergency}, zipcode = #{zipcode}, road_address = #{roadAddress}, detail_address = #{detailAddress} WHERE id = #{id}
